target.summary: Fall at home on Oct 2, 2026 with a skin tear to the left forearm; PT recommends a walker and home safety evaluation.

planted.text: Late entry, date correction: the fall recorded on Oct 2, 2026 actually occurred on Jun 27, 2026, before Debora's last IDT review, and was discussed at that meeting. It is not a new event for this review period.

headline: Debora has declined in bathing and lower-body dressing (now moderate assist), is avoiding showers out of fear of slipping, and her spouse caregiver Kevin reports exhaustion and requests respite.

items.statement: On 2026-10-26 OT found Debora needs moderate assistance with bathing and lower-body dressing; she was independent at the last review. OT recommends a tub transfer bench, handheld shower, and more home care hours for bathing.
items.verifier_note: Note n002 matches all details: date, moderate assistance, prior independence, and the three recommendations.

items.statement: On 2026-10-19 the home care aide reported Debora needed hands-on help to get out of the tub and has been skipping showers because she fears slipping.
items.verifier_note: Note n001 matches: hands-on help getting out of tub and skipping showers from fear of slipping.

items.statement: On 2026-10-13 spouse and primary caregiver Kevin reported exhaustion and poor sleep, worry about managing evenings alone, and requested respite. Respite options and a caregiver support group were discussed.
items.verifier_note: Note n007 matches all details: exhaustion, poor sleep, worry about evenings, respite request, and discussion of respite options and support group.

items.statement: PT evaluation on 2026-10-05: gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use, Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. PT recommends a front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and bathroom grab bars, and will see her twice weekly for strength and balance.
items.verifier_note: Note n006 matches all details: gait, TUG 19 s, the recommendations, and twice-weekly PT.

items.statement: Sertraline 25 mg was started 2026-09-13 for depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 of 14), with a recheck planned in 4 weeks. The pharmacist reconciled it on 2026-09-15. No recheck result is documented in the notes provided.
items.verifier_note: The start date, dose, indication, PHQ-9, and 4-week recheck are in n003. The pharmacist reconciliation on 2026-09-15 is in n004. No recheck result appears in the provided sources.
